records.author: Copilot
records.body:
Bootstrap repository with foundational structure for GPT-AJ03 "Enterprise Sleuth"—an AI detective for enterprise knowledge combining detective, analyst, and teacher roles using a 6-component prompt architecture.

## Added Files

- **LICENSE** - MIT License
- **.gitignore** - Build artifacts, dependencies, IDE/OS files, temporary files
- **gpt_manifest.yaml** - Project metadata, architecture components (CIR/OCE/IKM/CGC/ADO/CCI), repository structure mapping

## Created Directory Structure

```
prompts/              # Prompt templates and configurations
src/
  corpus/             # Knowledge-pack sources  
  transcripts/        # Conversation transcripts
eval/                 # Evaluation tests and benchmarks
build/                # Release artifacts
ops/                  # Operational configurations
```

## Enhanced README

Expanded documentation with:
- Explicit detective/analyst/teacher role descriptions
- Full prompt architecture component breakdown with expansions
- Structured sections for discoverability
- Links to canonical page and Notion documentation

Each directory includes `.gitkeep` with brief purpose description to ensure tracking.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> Create a new GitHub repo named AskJamie-GPT-AJ03. Initialize with README.md, LICENSE, and .gitignore. Add folders: prompts/, src/corpus/, src/transcripts/, eval/, build/, ops/. Add gpt_manifest.yaml. In README, describe GPT-AJ03 “Enterprise Sleuth” as an AI detective for enterprise knowledge—part detective/analyst/teacher—and a recipe pack/prompt architecture (CIR, OCE, IKM, CGC, ADO, CCI). Include links to the Notion page and https://askjamie.bot/lens-system/enterprise-sleuth/.
> 


</details>



<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT TIPS -->
---
